headline: Weathered Expanse Surges as Stonecradle Quiets
war_summary: The latest wires shift the centre of action since the morning edition, with the Weathered Expanse back to the fore counting five changes in two hours and twenty-six on the day about Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, now standing four Warden to four Colonial with one base in ruins and 12,787 Colonial and 15,186 Warden casualties on the day as hourly rates cool. Stlican Shelf follows with two changes in two hours and thirteen on the day about Thornhold, Fort Hoarfrost and The Old Mourn, held six Warden to three Colonial with 4,849 Colonial and 7,426 Warden losses. Stonecradle and Mooring County, lately the busiest sectors, have gone quiet with none in two hours after eight in six about World's End and The Dais and three in six about The Wind Hills and Wiccwalk respectively. Linn Mercy counts three in six and sixteen on the day about Lathair and Rotdust, while Dead Lands adds two in six about Callahan's Gate amid sharply quickening hourly losses. Nevish Line reports 5,418 Colonial and 3,301 Warden casualties with 1,091 new enlistments but no flips.
